quest.title: Despair Engulfs the Heavens
quest.description: The true master of the Abyssal power has emerged at last. The earth's corrosion intensifies and monsters are driven mad, the apocalyptic scene becoming a festering seedbed of impotent despair.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1225, Mora x53900, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Over here, come on! Quick!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wake up! You gotta wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaah!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're all dead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... were we too late?

dialogues.speaker: Osawe
dialogues.text: Aaah! No... Don't come any closer!

dialogues.speaker: Iyoba
dialogues.text: It's okay, sweetie, they're not monsters... I think they're here to help.

response.speaker: Iyoba
response.text: Thank you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened here?

response.speaker: Iyoba
response.text: The Abyss had us surrounded... Luckily, these Fatui came to our rescue, and we started evacuating.

response.speaker: Iyoba
response.text: But then that black fire shot out of the stadium, and that huge monstrosity appeared in the sky... Right after that, monsters suddenly appeared everywhere.

response.speaker: Iyoba
response.text: They couldn't fight them off, so... so they hid us here...

response.speaker: Osawe
response.text: *sobbing*...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You should keep moving. This is no place to hang around.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, you need to get to the stadium. C'mon, we'll take you.

response.speaker: Iyoba
response.text: Thank you... You saved our lives. We're forever indebted to you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is no "disaster"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is war.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yeah... Paimon knows, it's just... it hasn't fully sunk in yet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But anyway, right now, let's focus on getting them to the Stadium.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With any luck, there'll be an update waiting for us there. If not... we'll just have to play things by ear.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Everyone. Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: A bitter war lies ahead. Our victory begins in each of your minds... So ignite the spirit of victory for me.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: May no further lives be lost, and no one else made to suffer the loss of their loved ones.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "As long as blood still runs through your veins, even the tiniest spark of steel against stone can ignite a flame."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "Its blaze will become one with the gaze of all Natlan."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "Even amid everlasting darkness, our bonds remain eternal."

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: "Stone engraved and echoing peaks."

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: "Converge, disperse, in ashes be reborn."

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: "For flames born anew, and the blazing dawn."

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: "A hero scaled the volcano to seize the sun."

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: "Anointed with flames, she shone with the light of a thousand stars."

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: "Now, guide me in my first step."

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: "Having foretold his own death, the omniscient man holds a feast in celebration."

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: "Let us raise our cups in honor of his heroism and send him off with this final tribute."

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: "For, at last, his wish is now fulfilled."

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: "By past fuel, and present flame, life marches ever on."

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: "We will answer to the fire for all our deeds."

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: "My life's suffering shall be my epitaph."

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: "To remember the pain I endured, and finally, transcended."

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Heroes of the ages, our moment has finally come.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Stay back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah!

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Wait, y—you're... What happened to the monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duly slain.

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: All of them? But there were so many...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the situation here? Any other survivors?

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: The warriors protecting our group all fought to their deaths. We weren't about to sit around waiting to die, so we snuck out and made a run for it. But we didn't get far before the monsters spotted us...

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe we should've stayed put after all.

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: Ugh, when I was in my prime, I could have handled them all by myself... *cough* ... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You need to get out of here, now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Take our hot air balloon and head to the stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Oh... But won't that hold you up, if we take it?

dialogues.speaker: Jember
dialogues.text: What the...? How is anyone still here!? I thought the monsters had captured this place?

choices.text: Perfect timing. Can you escort them to safety?

response.speaker: Jember
response.text: Yes, of course! Leave them with us.

response.speaker: Jember
response.text: What's the matter? We need to go! It's not safe here.

response.speaker: Kunak
response.text: It's just... I can't help but think things might have turned out differently if only I'd chosen to fend for myself sooner, rather than expecting other people to protect me...

response.speaker: Libiac
response.text: It's not too late — maybe even for me. I might be an old bag of bones, but I used to train in the spear, and I bet I can still remember a thing or two.

response.speaker: Kunak
response.text: Let's get going. I'm gonna fight to the very end... just like they did.

response.speaker: Libiac
response.text: Thanks again for your help. We'll be alright from here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, but be extra careful on your way back! We'll see you at the stadium!

response.speaker: Kunak
response.text: You bet! Till then.

choices.text: We have somewhere else to be.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Over here, come on! Quick!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wake up! And you, wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Haronga
dialogues.text: They're all dead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... were we too late?

dialogues.speaker: Haronga
dialogues.text: We were on our way to the stadium with our saurians, when that dark entity emerged in the sky. Seconds later, the Abyss monsters appeared and changed into saurian form.

dialogues.speaker: Haronga
dialogues.text: They fought till the end to protect us... and now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should keep moving. This is no place to hang around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, you need to get to the stadium. C'mon, we'll take you.

dialogues.speaker: Haronga
dialogues.text: I guess... Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Haronga
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry, truly I am... May the Wayob watch over your souls, now and forever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is no "disaster"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is war.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—Yeah... Paimon knows, it's just... it hasn't fully sunk in yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But anyway, right now, let's focus on getting them to the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: With any luck, there'll be an update waiting for us there. If not... we'll just have to play things by ear.

talks.objective: Talk to the courier(s) at the Stadium

dialogues.speaker: Lliuyaq
dialogues.text: Need the latest battle report? We don't have too much information, since so few messengers are making it back here.

dialogues.speaker: Lliuyaq
dialogues.text: But as I understand, the folks at the Scions of the Canopy outpost suffered a large-scale Abyss attack as they were trying to evacuate civilians to the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Lliuyaq
dialogues.text: If you're free, please head there immediately.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Andinet
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. We'll manage for now, please go help the other affected areas.

dialogues.speaker: Tewodros
dialogues.text: Nowhere's safe from the Abyss monsters now, but at least they're still scared off by the Sacred Flame. We'll stay here and protect any refugees who have come here to seek sanctuary.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess you're the sole survivor, huh buddy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There there, don't be scared. Head to the Stadium, you'll be safe there. It's that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're upset, and nothing Paimon says can make it better... But you have to go right away, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stay strong.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, you're right. We have to keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The latest intel said the Children of Echoes need support too. Let's head over.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Great, you made it here unscathed!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Kinich came by just now with some really bad news: Those indestructible Abyss things have been dropped by all of the tribal territories.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: So it wasn't just the Children of Echoes. Even the Collective of Plenty was affected, and they're the furthest away.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: But the worst-affected region was the Flower-Feather Clan's. He said it's a complete disaster over there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Isn't that... Chasca's tribe? She said she was gonna take Chuychu home to rest for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Kinich didn't even stop to catch his breath before leaving for the Stadium. He said he was gonna try and assemble a team to go and support them, but...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: But how, right? Everyone's struggling just to defend themselves — there is no spare manpower. At this rate, it won't be long before even the Stadium is indefensible.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: And with everyone congregating at the Stadium, the Abyss forces will start converging there, too... Then, there'll be a battle on a scale much larger than anything we've seen so far.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: On the bright side, at least my old injuries aren't playing up at the moment. It means I can actually join in with the fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: The crux of the issue is that the heart of the Abyss itself has joined the invasion. That's a power we just can't match.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I have every faith in the courage of our people — the Natlanese will never give in to despair. But still... the fact is, our lives are more fragile than our spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon knows what you're about to say...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have to go to the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Paimon sure is getting tired from all this flying, but... It doesn't matter! Wherever you go, Paimon's going too!

choices.text: Until the Pyro Archon succeeds in her plan...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep. We'll leave the Children of Echoes to you guys. Flower-Feather Clan, hang in there, we're coming!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Really? But... you guys must be nearing your limit, surely!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If there was ever a time to push ourselves to the limit, that time is now!

choices.text: Every life we save is worth it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope... Nobody here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The latest intel said the Children of Echoes need support too. Let's head over.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: It's you... You came...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to the other warriors?

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: After you left, some of them started evacuating the civilians, while the rest stayed behind to keep guard... but they're all dead. I'm the only survivor.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: We're done for now. The Abyss will attack again any minute, and then I'll be a dead man too... The last few civilians holed up indoors won't stand a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hang in there, we'll think of something! There's gotta be a way out of this.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Like what? None of the civilians have any combat experience. There are old people, children, wounded... They can't defend themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: The monsters are gone for now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Get back inside. It's too dangerous out here.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: I know it's dangerous. That's why I came out.

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: Same.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Huh? What is this...?

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Can you spare some equipment for us?

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: I've never been in a battle before, but I'm young, and I can hold a weapon. That's gotta count for something.

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: And I used to fight in the Pilgrimage when I was a younger man. Admittedly, I never made it very far...

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: But if you hand me a spear, I think the old muscle-memory will kick in.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: There are others willing to join us as well. I persuaded them to fight. We can't let the blood spilled by our warrior brethren be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: We can't watch on as our heroes lose heart. And we can't let them fight alone.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Hmm, we don't have much equipment left...

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: ...Okay. Take these.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: With a few extra fighters, we should just about be able to hold our own. It'll be a slow advance, but that's better than being stuck here.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Everyone who's fighting, be prepared to follow my orders to the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: Yes Sir!

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Take our hot air balloon. You can use it to get to the stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Libiac
dialogues.text: No need, you'll have other people to save. We're taking up arms so that you can focus on more important things. You're the heroes, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, well... Try going that way. That's the route we came from, and there weren't too many monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Thank you both. You've been a huge help.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: I am devastated by the deaths of my brothers-in-arms. But if their sacrifice means anything, I have to live on.

dialogues.speaker: Kunak
dialogues.text: We're not going down without a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Achiyaku
dialogues.text: Thanks, we will. Now, go. There are other people to save out there.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: These monsters — they're what the winners of the Pilgrimage go on to fight, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: So that makes us veterans of the Night Warden Wars now, too.

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: I hadn't thought of it like that, but now that you mention it... Yeah. You're right.

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: Neither of us are name bearers, so in principle, we should never have had the chance to fight on the front lines. In that sense, this is... kind of a dream come true for us, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: We're not in this for fame, or glory, but for our childhood dreams of one day becoming a hero.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Follow the voice to find the survivor(s)
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: Oh, hey. It's you again.

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: It's a real shame I'm stuck here nursing my wounds, otherwise I'd be out there on the front line delivering the latest intel to you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the current situation out there?

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fewer and fewer messengers are making it back, and each trip seems to be taking longer than the last... It gives me a really bad feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: I'll update you on the latest intel for now. For next time though, I'll see if I can find someone to bring the updates directly to you.

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: I can't guarantee anything, though. As you know, we're seriously short on people.

choices.text: Don't worry about me. I'll manage.

response.speaker: Raman
response.text: Heh... I don't know how you do it. You really are a true hero.

choices.text: Save the intel for those who need it most.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Tochlan
dialogues.text: There you go, buddy. It's still gonna hurt for a few days, but apart from that, you're on the up and up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Toto? Toto, is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Toto
dialogues.text: Roar, roar ♪

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It IS you! Oh, thank goodness you're okay!

dialogues.speaker: Tochlan
dialogues.text: Toto was the only member of his family who didn't flee from the invasion. I don't know if he was being territorial or what, but he stayed and fought the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Tochlan
dialogues.text: If you hadn't gotten here when you did, he may not have made it.

dialogues.speaker: Tochlan
dialogues.text: We should let him rest here until he's able to stand again. I'll look after him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! Toto, next time you're told to evacuate, be a good saurian and do as you're told, okay? Otherwise, Kachina will be worried sick about you.

dialogues.speaker: Toto
dialogues.text: Roar...

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to the warriors stationed here

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: This is the second time you've had to come to our rescue... I'm a little ashamed.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Thanks to your efforts last time, we managed to fend off the Abyss here even after whatever that was appeared in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: But at this point... I think we're going to have to cut our losses. This base is as good as gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Everyone needs to stick together. Best to regroup somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Alright, time to evacuate. There's a volunteer unit here too, so first I need to ask them what they want to do next.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: For anyone who still wants to fight on the frontlines, the Children of Echoes' front is the closest to here. Anyone who wants to leave will likely also see action as they evacuate, but will be afforded safety at the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Those are the options. We're abandoning this base, and you're free to stay with the group or leave.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: As of this moment, the Children of Echoes are reasonably well-defended. So please, weigh the risks and consider your families' safety before you make a decision.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Now then. Anyone who wishes to keep fighting, show me how serious you are.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ...Did I not make myself clear?

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: But if Natlan is destroyed, will there still be a home for us to return to?

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: If anyone wants a future, it's on them to go out there and grab it. Period. No one wants to be that person who sat back and hoped for the best while other people were giving their blood for our nation.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Very well...

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ..."For Natlan."

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: ..."For Natlan!"

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: You heard them. This means we'll all be going to support the Children of Echoes garrison.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great. Well, you all seem in good spirits, so that's encouraging. But still, please be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it'll be just like another Night Warden War. We'll force the Abyss back if it's the last thing we do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shoot, that creepy Abyss thing is raining down a dangerous-looking substance again!

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ...That's over towards People of the Springs territory. From what I've heard, their defenses have been substantially weakened by the Abyss invasion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's head over and check on them!

talks.objective: Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to the warriors stationed here

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, you saved the day. The enemy attacks grow stronger with each wave... We're nearly at breaking point.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Given how few of us are left, I think it's time we cut our losses. This base is as good as gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Everyone needs to stick together. Best to regroup somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ...Better late than never. Time to evacuate. Warriors, gather 'round!

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: For anyone who still wants to fight on the frontlines, the Children of Echoes' front is the closest to here. Anyone who wants to leave will likely also see action as they evacuate, but will be afforded safety at the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Those are the options. We're abandoning this base, and you're free to stay with the group or leave.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: With our limited numbers, I can't promise that we'll be of any real assistance to the Children of Echoes' war effort, even if we do join them. Please bear this in mind as you make your decision.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Now then. Anyone who wishes to keep fighting, show me how serious you are.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ...Really? Even after my less-than-rousing speech?

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: Why would we give up now, after everything we've been through? We didn't stick it out this far just to admit defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Acama
dialogues.text: We can't give another inch to the Abyss. We have to fight them back — if not for our own sake, then at least for our fallen brethren.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Very well...

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ..."For Natlan."

dialogues.speaker: Yaretzi
dialogues.text: ..."For Natlan."

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: We may be few in number, but our will remains strong. We will join the ranks of the Children of Echoes and they will be stronger for it, however little.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... Well, take care of yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it'll be just like another Night Warden War. We'll force the Abyss back if it's the last thing we do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shoot, that creepy Abyss thing is raining down a dangerous-looking substance again!

dialogues.speaker: Chimalli
dialogues.text: ...That's over towards People of the Springs territory. From what I've heard, their defenses have been substantially weakened by the Abyss invasion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's head over and check on them!

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

dialogues.speaker: Komina
dialogues.text: May the Wayob grant you peace, and may songs be sung of your life's journey.

dialogues.speaker: Komina
dialogues.text: We give thanks for the gift of your life in ours. And we look forward to meeting you again one day, in a world of wonder and beauty.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Track the Abyssal contamination down to where it fell
Search for survivors or any information of value

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's just one battle report left, and it gives a long list of places where the "dangerous substance" has been dropping.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is the first report we've had in ages, which means the messengers' job has become all but impossible...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there's nothing we can do about that. Our priority is to get to the next affected zone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if we don't find any survivors, maybe... maybe that strange substance over there won't be as rock-solid as here? There's a chance, at least?

Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot
Speak to the people in the area

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Move out! You've gotta get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still no luck, huh. What on earth are these things? How are they invulnerable to attack?

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: Yeah, at least with regular Abyssal Pylons, anyone with a Vision can destroy them. But this thing? No one's seen anything like it before.

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: It's like... a part of that sky-demon's body, or something...

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: Whatever it is, it seems like it can spawn Abyssal Pylons — and with them, a never-ending stream of Abyss monsters. We're just no match for it.

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: At this point, retreat looks like our best option. We're fighting a losing battle here.

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: The Stadium is our only hope. That's where the sacred flame is, which seems to be the one thing that well of Abyssal energy is afraid of.

dialogues.speaker: Nellan
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon is guarding the flame. As long as that continues, we still have hope.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: Water, and some snacks — you look like you need it. I'm guessing you've been supporting the fight all over the map? Sounds like you need a breather.

dialogues.speaker: Maztla
dialogues.text: We've got enough people to hold our own here, and it's high time you took a break. Why don't you sit down and gather your strength for a minute?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's true, we've been fighting pretty much non-stop. {NICKNAME}, you must be exhausted, what do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right now, there are bigger things to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it?

choices.text: As long as that dark monstrosity remains unbeaten...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're right. Well then, guess we'd better go warn them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... It's your decision, if you wanna set off right away, Paimon will come with you!

choices.text: Gathering together might actually put a target on the Children of Echoes' back.

talks.objective: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Head to the Children of Echoes's camp

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you guys. Things are bad here — something fell out the sky that's impervious to our attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not just here. We've run into a few of these already.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Pacal gave the order for everyone to evacuate. Xilonen and I stayed behind as the rearguard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a good thing you did... otherwise, we might not have made it in time.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: #Kachina, {M#he}{F#she} and I can deal with the remaining monsters and Abyssal Pylons. You should go catch up with the rest of the group before your parents start worrying about you.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll leave right away — they need all the help they can get.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stay safe, Kachina!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Come on. Let's get this done.

talks.objective: Evac complete, prepare to fall back

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Yep, that's everyone, and no more casualties by the looks of things... This is good. We can evacuate shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I appreciate your help. How are things out there? Pretty dire, I bet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Extremely dire.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Some of the things I've seen, I don't know if I'll ever be able to get them out of my mind... Are we in Natlan doomed to this fate?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I've never witnessed a full-scale Abyss invasion before. I mean, I'd heard stories about the sky being painted black, but I always thought that was an exaggeration.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Mavuika has witnessed this all before, so she knew better than anyone the terror and despair an Abyss invasion would bring.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... and despite that, she's still facing it head on...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: We've had to abandon our homes and chase the dying light of day. Maybe the only time we'll see the dawn again is in our dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: But as long as there's even a sliver of hope, I'm not gonna give up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me neither.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: We should catch up with the group. Let's go.

talks.objective: Rendezvous with the team that evacuated first
Defeat the monsters surrounding Chasca and Chuychu

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Ugh... Aaargh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What happened to her? She's covered in Abyssal energy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help her.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Please... save her...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: How's that, Chuychu? Any better now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chuychu? Chuychu!

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Chasca... I used to think mom and dad were crazy for adopting you...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I was the younger sibling, but I always felt like it was my job to help mom and dad take care of you... I thought I could set you free from the Abyssal energy you struggled with...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I... guess I was pretty full of myself, huh? Thinking I could fix you, when... Well, we were always the same...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hush, Chuychu, put those thoughts right out of your mind. We'll be at the stadium in no time, okay? I'll carry you there.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The Abyssal contamination is gone now. Just rest, and you'll get better.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I was always nagging you to slow down, stop rushing headlong into things...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I just didn't want anything to happen to you, or to anyone else because of you...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I worried about you so much. But now, I realize... I never really understood what it's like for you.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: The fact that you survived an Abyssal contamination was a miracle, but it also left you in a constant state of agitation...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: The fact that we became family was another miracle. But with me worrying about you all the time, it feels like I just agitated you even further.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: No, absolutely not. Nothing could be further from the truth, do you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: All you ever did was love me, same goes for mom and dad. I've always known that, and I feel terrible, because I really did want to get along as a family.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It might take me some time, but I'll find a way to make it work. I'm so sorry, Chuychu, I never meant to make you feel this way...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: It's okay, Chasca. No need to apologize. You didn't do anything wrong — no one did. It's nobody's fault that things didn't turn out great.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I get it now. So, no nagging from me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: ...You keep forging ahead, Sis.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Never slow down, and never hold back. Spread your wings and fly free, like the fiercest qucusaur in the sky. Show the world who the bravest Flower-Feather warrior is...

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Because that's who you are... and that's the sister I'm proud of.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Chuychu... Chuychu!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Chuychu?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Ugh... Aaargh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chasca!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What... happened?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What was that just now? It looked like Abyssal energy was flowing out of her, but then a split-second later, it disappeared...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Chasca managed to rein it in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Chuychu did say that Chasca needs to let off steam now and then, or she'll end up losing herself. But this time, she wrestled back control.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just like Chuychu always hoped.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If only we were faster... Dealing with Abyssal contamination is a piece of cake for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We could've gotten to her earlier, then you could've treated her before... before it was too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... What's happening to Chasca...?

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: How unfair life can be... She's had the odds stacked against her from the very beginning, and each step forward has been an agonizing one. Maybe she would have been better off embracing her pain...

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: But her journey goes on, and one question looms large in her mind: If she could rise above the layers of pain, and ascend over the dark clouds of her mind... what, then, would she find?

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: Maybe the glorious light of the sun, or maybe a dark, empty void. There is only one way to find out. She needs to spread her wings and soar to new heights... that is the true meaning of life.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're from 500 years ago...

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: "My life's suffering shall be my epitaph."

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: "To remember the pain I endured..."

response.speaker: Menilek
response.text: "...And, finally, transcended."

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Let's take Chuychu somewhere safer.

choices.text: Let's give her some space while she cools down.

talks.objective: Bring Chuychu back to the Stadium with Chasca

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Please, take care of Chuychu for me...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I still have more important things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Komina
dialogues.text: Of course. We are grateful for her service.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yes, she served selflessly.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Chasca.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's alright. I'm far from the only one going through this right now.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Chuychu wanted to be a hero, and in my heart, she always will be.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If we want to honor what she stood for, not to mention her sacrifice... Archon, we need to hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Mm.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Time for this war to end.

talks.objective: Head to the center of the Stadium to witness the gathering of heroes

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That is an outright scary level of power...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: So from now on, all warriors will be able to resurrect themselves using the sacred flame...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: That's right. No more casualties.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It's time to wipe the enemy off the face of the earth.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: And to reclaim our lost territory.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: This is for all those who gave their lives for Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Everyone, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we'll come with you.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: #Paimon. {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'm so grateful you got to us when you did. You gave Chuychu the chance to say those words to me before the end...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If I'd lost control out there in the wild... This counter-attack might never have been possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Probably best not to think about that. More importantly... how are you feeling now? Any better?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Not really, but now's not the time to deal with it. In the spirit of Vu{RUBY#[D]Transcension}ka, I have to rise above it.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The conflict and suffering in me are there to test my character. My struggle will make me stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...And make me the person Chuychu believed I can be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have faith in you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go show the Abyss what human beings are made of! They'll be sorry they messed with Natlan after we're through with them!

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there. Need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: The items needed today are as such.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I reckon you've already collected one for the day, friend! Still, feel free to inspect the other boxes. As before, you'll find that I'm no cheat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you run me through your background again?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm Liben, and once upon a time, I sold curios.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm working hard these days to save up for a nice long vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of business are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Simple. You find me a few basic everyday items, cooking ingredients and the like, and then you trade them with me for a Box o' Marvels, full of all kinds of nice little treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Keep in mind that I've filled these Boxes o' Marvels with the fortune I made in my time as a seller of curios. There's no booby prizes to be found here, and I treat all my customers the same.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Why box them up and turn it into a lucky draw, you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What can I say, people like a gift box. It just makes everyone a little more inclined to get involved.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you earn any money like this?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: They say that everyone in Snezhnaya is tightening their belts, so there should be a business opportunity there or two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Ah, friend, we meet once more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Liben, where have you been raking in all that wealth lately?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Heh, I'm not exactly rolling in it like you think. Honestly, I might've even lost a few Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I was recently doing business at the Collective of Plenty. Someone took a look at my mushrooms and said:

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: "Hmm... They look rather... ordinary. Not like those of the mushroom god's."

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What in the world is a "mushroom god"? And is there some new variety of edible mushroom I should've known about?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: But I have to get home for the Lantern Rite whether there's money in my pocket or not. So, I've been running shorter trade routes recently — Dornman Port, for example.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It's just north of Mondstadt. Have you not been there before, friend?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, someone was holding me back, telling me we'll "explore it later."

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It's a port town built on cargo shipping and flower cultivation. Just looking at it makes you feel at ease.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: There used to be a very famous sanatorium up in the hills there, but it was torn down a few years ago.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: Speaking of which, it's actually kind of creepy. There's a pretty chilling saying about that sanatorium up in the hills...

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: They say that "anyone who visits the sanatorium will remain in those enchanted hills forever more."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Because the place is so comfortable that there's no reason to leave...?

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: I guess it's not so creepy if you look at it that way. Maybe that saying started because of the fresh air up there, far from all the dust and noise below.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: Hmm, it must be nice to live in the hills.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are plenty of beautiful mountains and other scenic spots in Liyue too.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: That's very true. But, alone in the mountains, you can't help but worry about things like getting food and water or the risk of being dragged off by wild animals. Especially since no one's really set up the kinds of services needed for a proper retreat yet.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It really has to be a proper retreat: pay to stay, get a nice rest, enjoy the opportunity to be close to nature. That's the only way one can feel truly comfortable.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: In any case, I'd better get busy since staying at a sanatorium costs money. Looks like it's business as usual for us, then?

dialogues.speaker: Raman
dialogues.text: Stay safe, heroes of Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Lliuyaq
dialogues.text: Best of luck. I hope to hear good news.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Chasca take Chuychu back to the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yet another place crawling with monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's clear the area and see if there are any survivors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Monsters everywhere you look, and... Oh no, looks like there's a saurian corpse...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like we'll be able to find anyone here... The monsters are all that's left.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These warriors are struggling! Quick, let's help them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the... Paimon can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, thank goodness! Those people are still standing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, over there! It's Chasca and Chuychu...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}!? Over here, hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are too many monsters... There are just too many, it's beyond anything we've seen before...
